description: Reviewed exceptions for locked crates that omit conventional license files. Regeneration checks the exact versions, packaged VCS/source receipts, and attribution hashes. No network access is needed to use these copies.

defmt-parser 1.0.0.note: The crate README points to the workspace-root MIT/Apache licenses, omitted from its package. This is the MIT option at the commit in its .cargo_vcs_info.json.

difflib 0.4.0.note: The package omits LICENSE and has no VCS receipt. Its original Cargo.toml and every src/*.rs file were compared byte-for-byte with this commit and matched; the listed hashes retain that comparison.

r-efi 6.0.0.note: The installed AUTHORS file contains the full MIT grant, copyright holders, and licensing alternatives. The upstream README explicitly routes licensing to AUTHORS; no README or source-code substitution is used.
